title: surwala robusta
intro: Surwala robusta, commonly known as the "Indian milk bush", is a plant species that belongs to the family Asclepiadaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as treating fever, reducing inflammation, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Surwala robusta include its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, making it a potential treatment for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
